comments.note: GrantsManagementViewModel.cs: LoadAsync is called once at startup by the service. If a RemoveGrantAsync or AddGrantAsync fails partway through (e.g., DB connection dropped), the in-memory Rows collection may diverge from DB state. Calling LoadAsync again after each failed mutation would self-heal the view.

GrantsManagementViewModel.cs: AddGrantAsync uses Rows collection to detect duplicates, but Rows is populated from ITagsRepository.GetAllGrantsAsync(). If the ITagsManager.DataChanged event fires during the session (from another dialog), GrantRows could become stale. Subscribing to DataChanged and reloading would prevent this.
No observations — code in the touched files is clean and consistent for the scope of this WP.

comments.note: No unit tests for GrantsManagementViewModel. FakeTagsManager available but not used here. GrantsManagementViewModel.AddGrantAsync: duplicate check is against in-memory Rows, which is populated from ITagsRepository.GetAllGrantsAsync() at LoadAsync time. If TagsManager.DataChanged fires during the session (another dialog modifies grants), Rows becomes stale and duplicates may slip through. Low-probability but worth noting.
